# Blyx GitHub Discussion Guidelines

Official Domain: https://blyx-lang.space

---

## Discussion Categories

1. **Q&A**: Technical help and compiler usage questions.
2. **Ideas & Proposals**: Informal feedback on potential new language features before filing an RFC.
3. **Show and Tell**: Projects, libraries, or applications built with Blyx.
4. **Announcements**: Release notes and ecosystem updates.

Please adhere to the [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) in all community interactions.
